To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the DataBoost- IM method improves the predictive accuracy of a base classifier, in particular for imbalanced data sets; 2) the method improves the predictive performance of a standard benchmarking algorithm for imbalanced data; and 3) the method compares well against three advanced boosting algorithms for imbalanced datasets.

DataBoost-IM is a new approach for learning from imbalanced data that combines boosting with data generation to produce a classifier with high predictive accuracy against both the minority and majority classes, and the method compares favorably against a base classifier, benchmarking boosting algorithm, and other boosting-based algorithms for dealing with imbalanced data.
